title: The First Mission
summary: Trapped inside the ancient subterranean chamber beneath Saint Mirren, Ha-Jun faces the Blood Trial against three colossal Sovereign Guardian Golems. Shattering the stone guardians with his demonic gauntlet, his synchronization jumps to 15%—revealing the second ancient relic: The Ring of Hollow Blood.

panels.action: Ha-Jun descends the ancient spiral staircase; each step echoes into the vast, hollow darkness below.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun descends the ancient spiral staircase; each step echoes into the vast, hollow darkness below.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun prachin sarpil sidhi se utarta hai; pratyek kadam neeche ke vishal, khokhale andhere mein goonjata hai.

panels.shot: wall texture shift to ancient basalt
panels.action: The walls transition from 1920s brickwork into ancient, prehistoric black basalt carved with glowing demonic glyphs.

dialogue.text: Insaani imarat ke neeche... daityon ka yug zinda tha.

panels.prose_en: The walls transition from 1920s brickwork into ancient, prehistoric black basalt carved with glowing demonic glyphs.
panels.prose_hi: Diwaren 1920 ke dashak ki inton se prachin, praagaitihaasik kale basalt mein parivartit ho gai hain jin par chamakdar shaitani demonic glyph ukere gaye han.

panels.action: Kuro glides ahead into the cavern, his eyes projecting twin crimson searchlight beams cutting through the purple miasma.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Savdhaan raho. Yahan ki hawa mein Abyssal Miasma bhara hua hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides ahead into the cavern, his eyes projecting twin crimson searchlight beams cutting through the purple miasma.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro gufa mein aage badhta hai, uski aankhen baingani mayasma ko kaatate hue judwan lal rang ki sarchlight kiranon ko prakshepit karti han.

panels.action: Breath puffs out in white vapor, yet Ha-Jun's skin feels pleasantly warm as sovereign blood circulates through his veins.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Itni thand mein bhi... mujhe garmi mehsoos ho rahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Breath puffs out in white vapor, yet Ha-Jun's skin feels pleasantly warm as sovereign blood circulates through his veins.
panels.prose_hi: Sans safed bhaap mein phoolti hai, phir bhi Ha-Jun ki tvacha sukhad roop se garm mahsoos hoti hai kyonki uski nason mein samprabhu khoon pravahit hota hai.

panels.action: They reach a colossal arched gateway guarded by twin 20-foot stone gargoyles holding giant ceremonial scythes.
panels.prose_en: They reach a colossal arched gateway guarded by twin 20-foot stone gargoyles holding giant ceremonial scythes.
panels.prose_hi: Ve ek vishal dhanushakar pravesh dwar tak pahunchte han, jo vishal aupcharik hansiya pakde hue judwan 20 foot ke patthar ke gargoil dwara sanrakshit hai.

panels.action: As Ha-Jun passes between them, the gargoyles' hollow stone eyes suddenly erupt in roaring violet hellfire.
panels.prose_en: As Ha-Jun passes between them, the gargoyles' hollow stone eyes suddenly erupt in roaring violet hellfire.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi Ha-Jun unke beech se gujarta hai, gargoils ki khokhli patthar ki aankhen achanak bhayankar baingani narkankaal mein phutne lagti han.

panels.action: A massive 10-ton stone slab crashes down behind Ha-Jun with earth-shattering finality, sealing the exit.
panels.prose_en: A massive 10-ton stone slab crashes down behind Ha-Jun with earth-shattering finality, sealing the exit.
panels.prose_hi: 10 ton ka ek vishal patthar ka slab Ha-Jun ke peeche prithvi-vidhwansak ant ke saath durghatnagrast ho jata hai, jisse nikas band ho jata hai.

panels.shot: turning back at seamless stone wall
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips around; the entrance has sealed seamlessly into solid basalt rock with zero cracks.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whips around; the entrance has sealed seamlessly into solid basalt rock with zero cracks.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun idhar-udhar ghumta hai; pravesh dwar ko shunya daraaron ke saath thos basalt chattan mein nirbaadh roop se seal kar diya gaya hai.

panels.action: A radiant purple system window flares: [TRIAL OBJECTIVE: PURGE THE GUARDIAN GOLEMS] | [REWARD: 15% SYNC & BLOOD MANIPULATION].
panels.prose_en: A radiant purple system window flares: [TRIAL OBJECTIVE: PURGE THE GUARDIAN GOLEMS] | [REWARD: 15% SYNC & BLOOD MANIPULATION].
panels.prose_hi: Ek deeptimaan baingani system window chamakti hai: [parikshan ka uddeshya: guardian golems ko shuddh karen] | [inam: 15% sink aur khoon herfer].

panels.action: Dozens of wall sconces around the vast circular chamber burst into purple fire simultaneously, illuminating ancient blood channels in the floor.
panels.prose_en: Dozens of wall sconces around the vast circular chamber burst into purple fire simultaneously, illuminating ancient blood channels in the floor.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal vrittakar kaksh ke charon or darjanon deewar ke nishan ek saath baingani aag mein foot gaye, jisse farsh mein prachin khoon channel roshan ho gaye.

panels.action: In the center of the arena stands a stepped obsidian sacrificial altar surrounded by glowing runic engravings.

dialogue.text: Ek prachin balivedi... jahan khoon ka daan diya jaata tha.

panels.prose_en: In the center of the arena stands a stepped obsidian sacrificial altar surrounded by glowing runic engravings.
panels.prose_hi: Akhade ke kendra mein ek sidhidar obsidian bali vedi hai jo chamakti runic nakkashi se ghiri hui hai.

panels.action: Violent subterranean tremors rip through the chamber floor; deep cracks spiderweb outward from the altar.
panels.prose_en: Violent subterranean tremors rip through the chamber floor; deep cracks spiderweb outward from the altar.
panels.prose_hi: Teevra bhumigat jhatke chamber ke farsh ko cheer dete han; vedi se bahar ki or makdi ke jaal mein gahri dararen.

panels.action: Three 10-foot tall basalt Guardian Golems fused with demonic bone armor and glowing red rune cores rise from the floor.
panels.prose_en: Three 10-foot tall basalt Guardian Golems fused with demonic bone armor and glowing red rune cores rise from the floor.
panels.prose_hi: Shaitani demonic asthi kavach aur chamakte lal roon core se jude teen 10 foot lambe basalt guardian golems farsh se uthte han.

panels.action: The golems heft massive boulder-sized stone warhammers, their crimson rune cores locking onto Ha-Jun with lethal intent.
panels.prose_en: The golems heft massive boulder-sized stone warhammers, their crimson rune cores locking onto Ha-Jun with lethal intent.
panels.prose_hi: Golems ne bade paimane par boulder aakaar ke patthar ke warhammer uthaye han, unke crimson roon core ghatak iraade se Ha-Jun par lock ho rahe han.

panels.action: Kuro circles above: 'Yeh Sovereign ke Gatekeepers hain! Inka pathar kisi bhi aam hathiyar se nahi toot sakta!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dhyan se! Inka pathar aam hathiyar se nahi tootega!

panels.prose_en: Kuro circles above: 'Yeh Sovereign ke Gatekeepers hain! Inka pathar kisi bhi aam hathiyar se nahi toot sakta!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne upar ghera: 'ye samprabhu ke dwarpal han! inka patthar kisi bhi aam hathiyare se nahin toot sakta!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun smirks calmly, snapping his fingers: The crystalline purple demonic gauntlet locks onto his right arm with crackling magenta arcs.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Achhi baat hai... kyunki mera hathiyar aam nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smirks calmly, snapping his fingers: The crystalline purple demonic gauntlet locks onto his right arm with crackling magenta arcs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shanti se muskurata hai, apni ungaliyan chatkata hai: crystaliy baingani shaitani demonic gauntlet uske dahine haath par magenta arcs ke saath chipak jata hai.

panels.action: The lead Golem charges with heavy thunderous strides, bringing its 5-ton stone hammer crashing straight down on Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: The lead Golem charges with heavy thunderous strides, bringing its 5-ton stone hammer crashing straight down on Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Mukhya golem bhari gadgdahat ke saath aage badhta hai, jisse uska 5 ton ka patthar ka hathauda sidhe Ha-Jun par girta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward and delivers a ferocious upward punch: His crystalline gauntlet meets the flat face of the descending 5-ton hammer head-on!
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward and delivers a ferocious upward punch: His crystalline gauntlet meets the flat face of the descending 5-ton hammer head-on!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai aur ek krur upar ki or mukka maarta hai: uska crystaliy hathiyar neeche utarte 5-tan ke hathaude ke sapat chehre se milta hai!

panels.action: Cracks spiderweb instantly across the boulder hammer before it detonates into a thousand flying shards of stone.
panels.prose_en: Cracks spiderweb instantly across the boulder hammer before it detonates into a thousand flying shards of stone.
panels.prose_hi: Patthar ke hajaron udne wale tukdon mein visphotit hone se pehle boulder hathaude par makdi ke jale ko turant tod deta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun flash-steps inside the Golem's guard, driving his fist deep into the glowing crimson rune core on its chest.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flash-steps inside the Golem's guard, driving his fist deep into the glowing crimson rune core on its chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun golem ke guard ke andar teji se kadam rakhta hai, apni mutthi ko uske seene par chamakte lal rang ke roon core mein gahrai tak ghusata hai.

panels.action: The red core shatters; the 10-foot golem crumbles into an inert mound of fractured cobblestones and dust.
panels.prose_en: The red core shatters; the 10-foot golem crumbles into an inert mound of fractured cobblestones and dust.
panels.prose_hi: Lal core bikhar jata hai; 10 foot ka golem khandit pattharon aur dhul ke ek nishkriya teele mein dhah jata hai.

panels.action: The remaining two Golems strike in tandem: One sweeps a wide stone blade at his legs while the second leaps from above with dual fists.
panels.prose_en: The remaining two Golems strike in tandem: One sweeps a wide stone blade at his legs while the second leaps from above with dual fists.
panels.prose_hi: Shesh do golem ek saath hamla karte han: ek uske pairon par ek vistrit patthar ka blade maarta hai, jabki dusra upar se dohri mutthiyon ke saath chhalang lagata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun expands his 5-meter Sovereign Domain: The falling airborne Golem freezes completely motionless mid-leap in mid-air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun expands his 5-meter Sovereign Domain: The falling airborne Golem freezes completely motionless mid-leap in mid-air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne 5-meter Sovereign domain ka vistar kiya: girta hua hawai golem madhya hawa mein chhalang ke beech puri tarah se gatiheen ho jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun launches off the frozen Golem's shoulder, spinning into a vertical axe kick engulfed in blazing violet-crimson hellfire.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun launches off the frozen Golem's shoulder, spinning into a vertical axe kick engulfed in blazing violet-crimson hellfire.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne jame hue golem ke kandhe ko launch kiya, jo dhadhakti bangni-lal rang ki narkankaal mein ghiri hui ek udhrvadhar kulhadi ki kick mein ghum raha tha.

panels.action: The flaming heel strike splits the second Golem cleanly from head to torso in an explosion of purple sparks.
panels.prose_en: The flaming heel strike splits the second Golem cleanly from head to torso in an explosion of purple sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Dhadhakti edi ka prahar dusre golem ko baingani chingari ke visfot mein sir se dhad tak saf-saf vibhajit kar deta hai.

panels.shot: blood claws decapitation of third golem
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands and extends Sovereign Blood Claws, slicing the retreating third Golem's stone head cleanly off its shoulders.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands and extends Sovereign Blood Claws, slicing the retreating third Golem's stone head cleanly off its shoulders.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun utarta hai aur Sovereign blood clause ko failata hai, peeche hatne wale teesre golem ke patthar ke sir ko uske kandhon se saaf kar deta hai.

panels.action: All three shattered rune cores turn into radiant streams of violet mana, absorbing into Ha-Jun's chest core.
panels.prose_en: All three shattered rune cores turn into radiant streams of violet mana, absorbing into Ha-Jun's chest core.
panels.prose_hi: Sabhi teen toote hue roon core baingani man ki ujjwal dharaon mein badal jaate han, jo Ha-Jun ki chhati ke core mein avshoshit ho jaate han.

panels.action: Golden system prompt chimes: [TRIAL 1 CLEARED: BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION 15.0%] | [NEW POWER: FLUID BLOOD CONTROL UNLOCKED].
panels.prose_en: Golden system prompt chimes: [TRIAL 1 CLEARED: BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION 15.0%] | [NEW POWER: FLUID BLOOD CONTROL UNLOCKED].
panels.prose_hi: Golden system prompt jhankar: [parikshan 1 saf: raktarekha tulyakalan 15.0%] | [nai shakti: drav khoon niyantran unlock].

panels.action: The central obsidian altar platform grinds open, revealing an ancient stone pedestal illuminated by a column of radiant scarlet light.
panels.prose_en: The central obsidian altar platform grinds open, revealing an ancient stone pedestal illuminated by a column of radiant scarlet light.
panels.prose_hi: Kendriy obsidian vedi manch khulta hai, jisse chamakdar lal rang ki roshni ke stambh dwara roshan ek prachin patthar ka kursi dikhai deta hai.

panels.shot: the ring of hollow blood cliffhanger
panels.action: Resting on a velvet cushion atop the pedestal is an antique carved silver ring embedded with a pulsating ruby tear: The Second Relic, Ring of Hollow Blood.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Doosra Relic... Ring of Hollow Blood.

panels.prose_en: Resting on a velvet cushion atop the pedestal is an antique carved silver ring embedded with a pulsating ruby tear: The Second Relic, Ring of Hollow Blood.
panels.prose_hi: Kursi ke upar ek makhmali gadde par ek prachin nakkashidar chandi ki anguthi rakhi hui hai, jo spandit ruby aansu ke saath jadit hai: dusra avshesh, khokhale khoon ki anguthi.
